findings.text: Routine swsusp_swap_in_use is visible outside its file and reports whether any hibernation swap extents are tracked, returning nonzero when extent root swsusp_extents holds at least one node and zero otherwise.
Global swsusp_hardware_signature holds thirty two bit hardware identity used to validate resumed hardware against hibernated hardware, defined alongside constant HIBERNATE_SIG.
Global swsusp_header_flags carries flag bits that travel in header swsusp_header toward the boot kernel that restores the image.
Routine is_hibernate_resume_dev is visible outside its file and indicates whether a given device equals recorded device dev in snapshot_state, but only when hibernation support is present.

Routine _braille_console_setup is visible outside its file and interprets console option text for braille handling, recognizing short marker brl with comma and longer assignment brl with equals that carries options and port name.
Helper braille_set_options records braille options pointer brl_options into console descriptor field of console_cmdline for later console setup.

Structure swap_map_page stores fixed array entries of swap sector locations plus chaining sector next_swap, while list element swap_map_page_list pairs pointer map with link next to chain allocated maps.

Structure swap_map_handle tracks swap map iteration with current page cur, owned maps list maps, current sector cur_swap, first sector first_sector, index k, required free pages reqd_free_pages, and running checksum crc32.

Structure swsusp_header describes on swap hibernation header with large reserved padding, hardware signature hw_sig, checksum crc32, image location image, flag word flags, and two ten character tags orig_sig and sig, stored packed.
Structure swsusp_extent represents contiguous swap range with tree node node plus start and end offsets, anchored by global root swsusp_extents that is empty when no swap is in use.
Structure hib_bio_batch coordinates hibernation block batch with atomic count count, wait queue wait, latched error error, and embedded plug plug for merging.

Structure crc_data controls checksum worker with thread thr, ready flag ready, stop flag stop, active count run_threads, queues go and done, checksum pointer crc32, length pointers unc_len, and flexible tail unc of data pointers.

Structure cmp_data holds compression worker state with thread thr, compressor cc, request cr, flags ready and stop, return ret, queues go and done, lengths unc_len and cmp_len, and inline buffers unc and cmp sized for one chunk and its worst case form.

Structure dec_data mirrors compression state for decompression with thread thr, compressor cc, request cr, flags ready and stop, return ret, queues go and done, lengths unc_len and cmp_len, and paired buffers unc and cmp.

Structure snapshot_data captures hibernation session with handle handle, swap index swap, mode mode, flags frozen ready platform_support free_bitmaps, and device dev, instantiated once as snapshot_state with helper flag need_wait for probe waiting.
Structure compat_resume_swap_area defines packed compatibility layout for resume swap designation with compat offset offset and thirty two bit device code dev.
Structure wakelock pairs name name with tree node node and wakeup source ws, plus optional list link lru when collection is enabled, indexed by global root wakelocks_tree under mutex wakelocks_lock.

File operations snapshot_fops bind handlers snapshot_open snapshot_release snapshot_read snapshot_write snapshot_ioctl and compat snapshot_compat_ioctl, exposed through misc device snapshot_device with fixed minor and textual name.
Attribute array g with group attr_group exposes compression threads control under power object for user tuning.
Constant MAP_PAGE_ENTRIES equals page size divided by sector identifier size minus one slot for chaining, ensuring each swap_map_page fits exactly one page.
Header swsusp_header reserved area is sized so reserved plus hw_sig plus crc32 plus image plus flags plus orig_sig plus sig exactly occupy one page, with packed layout preventing gaps.

Chunk sizing uses constants UNC_PAGES UNC_SIZE CMP_HEADER CMP_PAGES CMP_SIZE where uncompressed size is thirty two pages, header is native word size, and compressed size is worst case plus header rounded up to pages.

Variable hibernate_compression_threads defaults to constant CMP_THREADS with value three and is kept at least one by boot handler hibernate_compression_threads_setup and store handler hibernate_compression_threads_store.

Suspend test label test_state_label requires exact match against known labels in setup_test_suspend and against known states in test_suspend, warning through warn_bad_state and aborting on mismatch or when unset.

Snapshot open snapshot_open allows read only for image creation and write only for image loading, rejects read write access, requires hibernation availability and exclusive acquisition, and initializes handle swap mode and flags per direction.

Snapshot read snapshot_read fails unless ready is set and fetches fresh page only on page boundaries before copying from handle data, while write snapshot_write fetches fresh destination on boundaries and fails when data buffer is missing, both advancing offset by transferred bytes.
Snapshot ioctl snapshot_ioctl validates magic and command range, requires administrator privilege, and acquires system transition mutex without blocking plus device hotplug lock before dispatch.

Wakelock collection uses constants WL_GC_COUNT_MAX WL_GC_TIME_SEC with one hundred pending entries and three hundred seconds idle, counter wakelocks_gc_count reset after each sweep, and count number_of_wakelocks adjusted only when collection support is active via decrement_wakelocks_number variants.

Braille parsing in _braille_console_setup treats leading brl with comma as empty options, brl with equals as options up to comma introducing port name, and reports error when port separator is missing.

Workers crc32_threadfn compress_threadfn decompress_threadfn share ready plus stop protocol where controller sets ready and wakes go, worker clears ready while working then sets stop and wakes done, with stop requests clearing ownership thr and waking done for teardown.

Completion hib_end_io releases page reference on writes, optionally flushes cache on reads when clean_pages_on_read is set, latches only first block error into batch error, and wakes waiters exactly when last operation completes.

Swap area assignment snapshot_set_swap_area refuses changes while swsusp_swap_in_use reports busy, decodes device and offset from compat or native structures, releases prior pinning, and records new swap index and device dev or returns device errors.

Global atomic compressed_size accumulates total compressed bytes across workers, opaque holder swsusp_holder reserves swap ownership, root index root_swap defaults to all bits set meaning none, and file hib_resume_bdev_file tracks resume device.
Compressed read window is bounded by constants CMP_MIN_RD_PAGES and CMP_MAX_RD_PAGES between one thousand twenty four and eight thousand one hundred ninety two pages.
Compat ioctl snapshot_compat_ioctl forwards size and image commands through pointer conversion while passing others unchanged to snapshot_ioctl, after asserting offset width equivalence.
Decompression cache maintenance is gated by flag clean_pages_on_decompress that triggers flush over exactly produced byte range after each chunk.

Mutex wakelocks_lock serializes garbage collection access to tree wakelocks_tree, least recently used list, and counters, held for entire sweep in __wakelocks_gc and released after resetting wakelocks_gc_count.
Each wakeup source lock in ws protects snapshot of idle time last_time and active flag active while deciding reclamation in __wakelocks_gc.
Batch hib_bio_batch count wait error provides completion barrier where each hib_end_io decrements count and final decrement wakes single waiter observing latched error.
Paired queues go and done plus atomics ready and stop form two phase rendezvous for crc_data cmp_data dec_data that starts work and confirms completion without holding mutex across crypto operations.
System sleep lock is acquired in snapshot_open and snapshot_release to stabilize power state across hibernate acquisition, notifier chains, bitmap handling, swap pinning, and process freeze or thaw.
Snapshot read snapshot_read and write snapshot_write each hold system sleep lock only for handle advancement and user buffer transfer, preventing concurrent image state changes.
Snapshot ioctl snapshot_ioctl combines nonblocking attempt on system transition mutex with device hotplug lock to exclude concurrent power transitions and topology changes during command execution.

Suspend test moves from unset test_state_label to parsed label via setup_test_suspend, to validated state via test_suspend matching, to RTC discovery, to wakealarm test and cleanup, aborting with warning at any failed precondition.

Snapshot session moves from closed to open in one direction via snapshot_open, to frozen after freeze and bitmap creation, to ready after image creation, to consumed or freed, returning to thawed and released with cleanup in snapshot_release.

Ioctl dispatch drives transitions for freeze and unfreeze, image creation and atomic restore with guards, image freeing with thread thaw, size queries, swap page allocation and freeing, memory suspend, platform support toggling, platform power off, and swap area selection.

Compression worker compress_threadfn loops between idle wait and active compression, publishing compressed length cmp_len and accounting compressed_size on success and handling stop by clearing thr and reporting failure before exiting.
Checksum worker crc32_threadfn loops between idle wait and active accumulation over run_threads streams, folding bytes into shared crc32 before signaling completion or handling stop.

Decompression worker decompress_threadfn loops between idle wait and active expansion, publishing unc_len and optionally flushing caches when clean_pages_on_decompress is set before signaling completion or handling stop.

Collection sweep __wakelocks_gc walks least recently used list from oldest toward newest, stopping at first sufficiently fresh entry and reclaiming only inactive aged entries by unregistering ws and freeing name and node.
Swap selection transitions from unpinned to pinned by releasing prior selection then pinning newly decoded device and offset and recording dev for later matching by is_hibernate_resume_dev.
Boot handler setup_test_suspend runs early to capture suspend label and optional repeat count for later automated testing.
Init routine test_suspend runs after power and RTC initialization to validate requested state and drive wakealarm based suspend test when possible.
Init routine swsusp_header_init creates power sysfs group attr_group and allocates one page for swsusp_header, failing boot if allocation is impossible.

Boot option hibernate_compression_threads_setup plus sysfs handlers hibernate_compression_threads_show and hibernate_compression_threads_store provide early and runtime control of hibernate_compression_threads with shared lower bound.

Snapshot handlers snapshot_open snapshot_release snapshot_read snapshot_write snapshot_ioctl with compat wrapper snapshot_compat_ioctl form user control plane for hibernation image creation and restore.
Init routine snapshot_device_init registers misc device snapshot_device so user space can open control node.
Work handler __wakelocks_gc performs deferred reclamation of aged inactive wakelocks without blocking creation or activation paths.
Callback hib_end_io finalizes one hibernation page transfer with direction specific cleanup and batch accounting.
Thread entries crc32_threadfn compress_threadfn decompress_threadfn implement long lived workers that sleep until signaled and exit cleanly on stop requests.
Block errors during hibernation are logged with device numbers and sector position in hib_end_io and only first error is retained for batch, so later errors are obscured.
Cache maintenance depends on flags clean_pages_on_read and clean_pages_on_decompress, and missing required flush on architectures needing it can execute stale data.
Failure to allocate header page in swsusp_header_init halts system immediately, so early memory pressure prevents boot.
Snapshot open snapshot_open error paths must unwind swap pinning and hibernate acquisition plus notifier effects, otherwise swap stays pinned or hibernation stays busy.
Snapshot write snapshot_write can encounter valid page index with missing data buffer and must reject transfer rather than copying to null destination.
Ioctl commands in snapshot_ioctl enforce frozen ready and direction preconditions, and bypassing checks could suspend devices or restore images from inconsistent process state.
Reclamation in __wakelocks_gc must verify inactivity under lock and age against monotonic time, freeing only after removal from wakelocks_tree and list to avoid use after free.
Missing port separator after braille assignment in _braille_console_setup triggers error message and failure return, preventing silent use of unspecified port.

Thread count updates in hibernate_compression_threads_store and hibernate_compression_threads_setup reject unparsable input and values below one, preventing zero worker configuration that could stall hibernation.
Release snapshot_release must distinguish frozen sessions needing thaw and bitmap release from unfrozen sessions needing only conditional bitmap release, plus notifier and swap cleanup in both cases.
Constant HIBERNATE_SIG uses eight characters S 1 S U S P E N D to tag valid images on swap.
Constant MAP_PAGE_ENTRIES defines swap map capacity as page size divided by sector identifier size minus one for chaining.
Constant CMP_HEADER defines per chunk compression header length as size of native length word.
Constants UNC_PAGES and UNC_SIZE define uncompressed chunk geometry with thirty two pages per chunk.
Constants CMP_PAGES and CMP_SIZE define compressed buffer geometry from worst case size for one chunk plus header rounded up to whole pages.
Constant CMP_THREADS defines default compression parallelism as three threads for hibernate_compression_threads.
Constants CMP_MIN_RD_PAGES and CMP_MAX_RD_PAGES bound compressed read readahead between one thousand twenty four and eight thousand one hundred ninety two pages.
Constants WL_GC_COUNT_MAX and WL_GC_TIME_SEC bound wakelock collection to one hundred pending entries and three hundred seconds idle time.
Macro pr_fmt for power management prepends letters P M followed by colon and space to messages.
Macro pr_fmt for braille prepends module name followed by colon and space to messages.
Header guard _PRINTK_BRAILLE_H prevents multiple inclusion of braille definitions.
Misc device snapshot_device with operations snapshot_fops uses textual name snapshot and minor SNAPSHOT_MINOR.
Header swsusp_header carries two ten character signature fields orig_sig and sig plus thirty two bit hw_sig crc32 and flags fields.
